name: PIRA-Bench
intro: PIRA-Bench 是一个面向主动式 GUI 助手的基准，用连续屏幕轨迹、用户画像和噪声片段评估模型在无显式指令下提前识别用户意图并给出推荐的能力。
org: MMLab @ CUHK, Nankai University, Huawei Research
build_method: 已标注轨迹, 用户画像配对, 连续视觉输入
metric: Average Intent F1, Normalized False Positive Score, Final Score
eval_feature: 长轨迹, 噪声浏览, 多线程任务切换
scale: 100条轨迹, 平均32张截图, 每条轨迹3个用户画像
intro_en: PIRA-Bench evaluates proactive GUI agents on continuous screen trajectories. It measures whether MLLMs can infer profile-aligned user intent from noisy multi-threaded screenshots without explicit instructions.
build_method_en: annotated trajectories, user-profile pairing, continuous visual inputs
metric_en: Average Intent F1, Normalized False Positive Score, Final Score
eval_feature_en: Long-horizon Trajectories, Noisy Browsing, Multithreaded Task-switching
scale_en: 100 trajectories, 32 screenshots on average, 3 user profiles per trajectory
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从真实移动端与桌面端操作中收集长轨迹截图"] --> B["按轨迹切分连续 GUI 状态并保留时序"]
    B --> C["为每条轨迹配对 3 个不同用户画像"]
    C --> D["标注可行动意图、噪声片段与多线程任务切换"]
    D --> E["构建直接推荐、画像依赖和无意图负样本三类场景"]
    E --> F["让模型仅基于连续截图与画像主动推荐意图"]
    F --> G["分别计算 Intent F1 与误报惩罚"]
    G --> H["汇总 Average Intent F1、FPSnorm 与 Final Score"]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect long GUI trajectories from real mobile and desktop activity"] --> B["Segment each trajectory into time-ordered screenshot states"]
    B --> C["Pair every trajectory with three distinct user profiles"]
    C --> D["Annotate actionable intents, noisy segments, and multi-thread task switches"]
    D --> E["Build direct-intent, profile-dependent, and no-intent scenarios"]
    E --> F["Ask models to proactively recommend intents from screenshots and profiles alone"]
    F --> G["Compute intent quality and false-positive penalties separately"]
    G --> H["Aggregate Average Intent F1, FPSnorm, and the final score"]
